card.name: Web page footer and notice text
card.fires_on: Words in website footer or notice text, such as the start of a sentence after a notice, 'Note:', or 'Need help identifying pills'. It fires on the next word in stock page-ending messages.

modes.label: Notice sentence openers
modes.description: The first word or colon in a short site notice, such as 'If' or 'Note:'.
